claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Arecaidine-but-2-ynyl-ester is a selective muscarinic M2 acetylcholine receptor agonist that is unlikely to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, likely reflecting off-target cytotoxicity rather than a specific mechanism class.
